device.name: SPDR Bot quadruped direct task (Isaac Lab)

facts.text: The package registers the Gymnasium task Template-Spdrbot3-Direct-v0 with entry point spdrbot3_env:Spdrbot3Env and the configuration spdrbot3_env_cfg:Spdrbot3EnvCfg
Spdrbot3Env is a concrete DirectRLEnv subclass: it implements the scene setup, action application, observations, rewards, dones and reset methods
The environment config declares action_scale = 1, action_space = 12, observation_space = 48 and state_space = 0
The environment config sets episode_length_s = 20.0 and decimation = 4
The simulation config uses a timestep of 1/200 s and render_interval = 1
Each action is multiplied by action_scale and added to the robot's default joint positions, then written with set_joint_position_target
The policy observation concatenates root linear velocity, root angular velocity, projected gravity, the commands, joint positions minus defaults, joint velocities and the actions
The reward is the sum of eight terms: linear velocity tracking, yaw-rate tracking, z velocity, xy angular velocity, joint torques, joint acceleration, action rate and flat orientation
The eight reward scales are 5.0, 0.5, -2.0, -0.05, -1e-5, -1e-7, -0.01 and -5.0
An episode times out when episode_length_buf >= max_episode_length - 1, and is marked died when the maximum contact-force norm over the history on a selected die body exceeds 1.0
The die body ids are arm_a_1_1, arm_a_2_1, arm_a_3_1 and arm_a_4_1
A full reset resets the robot and the environment buffer, clears the actions, samples the three commands uniformly from -1.0 to 1.0, and writes the default root pose, root velocity and joint state
The scene configures 200 environments with an environment spacing of 2.0
The contact sensor uses a history length of 5 and an update period of 0.005 s
The environment config imports SPDRBOT_CFG from isaaclab_assets.robots.spdrbot
The root spdrbot.py defines SPDRBOT_CFG with the USD asset path C:/spdrbot3/spdrbot3/spdr.usd
The root SPDRBOT_CFG lists twelve Revolute joints 110 to 121 with default positions 0.0 or 0.5 and one implicit actuator group with effort_limit 5.0, velocity_limit 1, stiffness 40.0 and damping 1.0
The README describes SPDR Bot as a four-legged robot designed for simulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and lists the URDF, USD assets and a sample control script
The direct-project README says to install Isaac Lab first and then install this project in editable mode from source/spdrbot3
The setup script declares license MIT and python_requires >=3.10
The setup script's classifiers name Isaac Sim 4.5.0
The extension declares isaaclab, isaaclab_assets, isaaclab_mimic, isaaclab_rl and isaaclab_tasks as dependencies
The environment file header declares SPDX-License-Identifier BSD-3-Clause
The URDF description's LICENSE says MIT License and credits Toshinori Kitamura (2018)
The README says the project is open for personal and educational use and suggests attribution for published work

determinism.notes: reset(seed) selects Python's random.Random for the three command samples; the fake is reproducible for a seed.  The upstream uses the Isaac Lab torch RNG and its simulation state, so one seed does not give the same trajectory on the two.

gaps: analytic F0 model: the twelve joints follow the commanded position directly; there are no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors, noise or terrain
the fake presents one environment and keeps the batched shapes of num_envs = 1; the upstream configures 200 environments (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:92), and multi-environment control is not exposed

the fake's action space is a placeholder unbounded 12-value Box: the clone states only action_space = 12 (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:54), while the external DirectRLEnv defines the real bounds; accepting an arbitrary finite value in the fake establishes no upstream action bound

the policy observation is a 48-value placeholder vector with the upstream layout: root velocities, projected gravity, joint defaults, joint velocities and the reward inputs are placeholders, and no trajectory was compared with the upstream simulator

the upstream observation_space is the external DirectRLEnv's batched policy Box while _get_observations returns a {'policy': ...} dict (spdrbot3_env.py:79-98); the fake declares a Dict space so the announced space and the returned observation agree, which is an adaptation
the upstream reward formula is evaluated on the fake's placeholder zero root velocities, torques and accelerations; the values are not the simulator's reward
terminated is always false: the contact-force death check (spdrbot3_env.py:138-145) needs the contact sensor the fake does not model

the fake starts every episode at episode_length_buf 0 and chooses a timeout of 999 steps, from episode_length_s 20.0 / (dt 1/200 * decimation 4) and the >= max_episode_length - 1 comparison (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:51-60, spdrbot3_env.py:139); the external base's max_episode_length calculation is outside this clone and was not verified, and the upstream randomizes the buffer on a full reset (spdrbot3_env.py:152-154)
the fake returns Python lists with scalar reward and termination flags instead of torch tensors; the external DirectRLEnv step lifecycle and autoreset behavior were not verified
the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id with Isaac Lab) was not run and the task is not declared as a sim backend; the implicit path needs the external stack and the caller's cfg
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

licence declarations differ across the clone: setup.py:35 says MIT, the environment header says BSD-3-Clause, the URDF description has an MIT LICENSE, and README.md:46-48 describes personal and educational use; the card requires an owner publication decision

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the fake simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable; no stop is sent to Isaac Sim and this package declares only the fake backend
